messages.subject: Way to extract model-estimated skewness and kurtosis from tidyLPA?
messages.subject_clean: Way to extract model-estimated skewness and kurtosis from tidyLPA?
messages.body_plain:
Hello!

We’re hoping to compare observed and model-estimated skewness and kurtosis as part of our model fit checks, similar to the structure outlined by Dr. Masyn in The Oxford Handbook of Quantitative Methods (vol 2, chapter 25). Is it possible to extract model-estimated skewness and kurtosis statistics from tidyLPA?

Thanks for your help!

Best,

Amanda
